description: Envoy AI Gateway / Agent Router external processor (/metrics on admin port 1064): LLM requests, errors, latency, TTFT, tokens by type (OpenTelemetry GenAI names) and the MCP proxy (methods, errors, latency, capabilities).

panels.title: LLM requests/s
panels.description: LLM requests processed by the gateway.

targets.expr: sum(rate(gen_ai_server_request_duration_seconds_count{namespace=~"$namespace", pod=~"$pod", otel_scope_name="envoyproxy/ai-gateway", gen_ai_request_model=~"$model", gen_ai_backend=~"$backend"}[$__rate_interval]))

panels.title: LLM error ratio
panels.description: Requests recorded with an error.type attribute (failed upstream or gateway processing).

targets.expr: (sum(rate(gen_ai_server_request_duration_seconds_count{namespace=~"$namespace", pod=~"$pod", otel_scope_name="envoyproxy/ai-gateway", gen_ai_request_model=~"$model", gen_ai_backend=~"$backend", error_type!=""}[$__rate_interval])) or vector(0)) / sum(rate(gen_ai_server_request_duration_seconds_count{namespace=~"$namespace", pod=~"$pod", otel_scope_name="envoyproxy/ai-gateway", gen_ai_request_model=~"$model", gen_ai_backend=~"$backend"}[$__rate_interval]))

panels.title: Request p95
panels.description: 95th percentile LLM request duration, headers in to last byte out.

targets.expr: histogram_quantile(0.95, sum by (le) (rate(gen_ai_server_request_duration_seconds_bucket{namespace=~"$namespace", pod=~"$pod", otel_scope_name="envoyproxy/ai-gateway", gen_ai_request_model=~"$model", gen_ai_backend=~"$backend"}[$__rate_interval])))

panels.title: TTFT p95
panels.description: 95th percentile time to first token on streaming responses.

targets.expr: histogram_quantile(0.95, sum by (le) (rate(gen_ai_server_time_to_first_token_seconds_bucket{namespace=~"$namespace", pod=~"$pod", otel_scope_name="envoyproxy/ai-gateway", gen_ai_request_model=~"$model", gen_ai_backend=~"$backend"}[$__rate_interval])))

panels.title: Tokens/s
panels.description: Input + output tokens per second.

targets.expr: sum(rate(gen_ai_client_token_usage_sum{namespace=~"$namespace", pod=~"$pod", otel_scope_name="envoyproxy/ai-gateway", gen_ai_request_model=~"$model", gen_ai_backend=~"$backend", gen_ai_token_type=~"input|output"}[$__rate_interval]))

panels.title: MCP requests/s
panels.description: MCP methods handled by the MCP proxy.

targets.expr: sum(rate(mcp_method_count_total{namespace=~"$namespace", pod=~"$pod", otel_scope_name="envoyproxy/ai-gateway"}[$__rate_interval]))

panels.title: Requests by model and provider
panels.description: LLM requests per requested model and upstream provider.

targets.expr: sum by (gen_ai_request_model, gen_ai_provider_name) (rate(gen_ai_server_request_duration_seconds_count{namespace=~"$namespace", pod=~"$pod", otel_scope_name="envoyproxy/ai-gateway", gen_ai_request_model=~"$model", gen_ai_backend=~"$backend"}[$__rate_interval]))

panels.title: Errors by model and type
panels.description: Failed requests per model.

targets.expr: sum by (gen_ai_request_model, error_type) (rate(gen_ai_server_request_duration_seconds_count{namespace=~"$namespace", pod=~"$pod", otel_scope_name="envoyproxy/ai-gateway", gen_ai_request_model=~"$model", gen_ai_backend=~"$backend", error_type!=""}[$__rate_interval]))

panels.title: Requests by operation
panels.description: chat, completion, embeddings, messages, responses, rerank, image_generation...

targets.expr: sum by (gen_ai_operation_name) (rate(gen_ai_server_request_duration_seconds_count{namespace=~"$namespace", pod=~"$pod", otel_scope_name="envoyproxy/ai-gateway", gen_ai_request_model=~"$model", gen_ai_backend=~"$backend"}[$__rate_interval]))

panels.title: Requests by AI backend
panels.description: Requests per AIServiceBackend (namespace/name) that served them.

targets.expr: sum by (gen_ai_backend) (rate(gen_ai_server_request_duration_seconds_count{namespace=~"$namespace", pod=~"$pod", otel_scope_name="envoyproxy/ai-gateway", gen_ai_request_model=~"$model", gen_ai_backend=~"$backend"}[$__rate_interval]))

panels.title: Request duration
panels.description: From request headers in the external processor to the end of the response body.

targets.expr: histogram_quantile(0.5, sum by (le) (rate(gen_ai_server_request_duration_seconds_bucket{namespace=~"$namespace", pod=~"$pod", otel_scope_name="envoyproxy/ai-gateway", gen_ai_request_model=~"$model", gen_ai_backend=~"$backend"}[$__rate_interval])))

histogram_quantile(0.95, sum by (le) (rate(gen_ai_server_request_duration_seconds_bucket{namespace=~"$namespace", pod=~"$pod", otel_scope_name="envoyproxy/ai-gateway", gen_ai_request_model=~"$model", gen_ai_backend=~"$backend"}[$__rate_interval])))

histogram_quantile(0.99, sum by (le) (rate(gen_ai_server_request_duration_seconds_bucket{namespace=~"$namespace", pod=~"$pod", otel_scope_name="envoyproxy/ai-gateway", gen_ai_request_model=~"$model", gen_ai_backend=~"$backend"}[$__rate_interval])))

panels.title: Time to first token
panels.description: Streaming responses only.

targets.expr: histogram_quantile(0.5, sum by (le) (rate(gen_ai_server_time_to_first_token_seconds_bucket{namespace=~"$namespace", pod=~"$pod", otel_scope_name="envoyproxy/ai-gateway", gen_ai_request_model=~"$model", gen_ai_backend=~"$backend"}[$__rate_interval])))

histogram_quantile(0.95, sum by (le) (rate(gen_ai_server_time_to_first_token_seconds_bucket{namespace=~"$namespace", pod=~"$pod", otel_scope_name="envoyproxy/ai-gateway", gen_ai_request_model=~"$model", gen_ai_backend=~"$backend"}[$__rate_interval])))

histogram_quantile(0.99, sum by (le) (rate(gen_ai_server_time_to_first_token_seconds_bucket{namespace=~"$namespace", pod=~"$pod", otel_scope_name="envoyproxy/ai-gateway", gen_ai_request_model=~"$model", gen_ai_backend=~"$backend"}[$__rate_interval])))

panels.title: Request duration p95 by model
panels.description: Latency per requested model.

targets.expr: histogram_quantile(0.95, sum by (le, gen_ai_request_model) (rate(gen_ai_server_request_duration_seconds_bucket{namespace=~"$namespace", pod=~"$pod", otel_scope_name="envoyproxy/ai-gateway", gen_ai_request_model=~"$model", gen_ai_backend=~"$backend"}[$__rate_interval])))

panels.title: Time per output token p95 by model
panels.description: (duration - TTFT) / (output tokens - 1), successful responses only.

targets.expr: histogram_quantile(0.95, sum by (le, gen_ai_request_model) (rate(gen_ai_server_time_per_output_token_seconds_bucket{namespace=~"$namespace", pod=~"$pod", otel_scope_name="envoyproxy/ai-gateway", gen_ai_request_model=~"$model", gen_ai_backend=~"$backend"}[$__rate_interval])))

panels.title: Tokens by type
panels.description: input, output, cached_input, cache_creation_input and reasoning tokens per second.

targets.expr: sum by (gen_ai_token_type) (rate(gen_ai_client_token_usage_sum{namespace=~"$namespace", pod=~"$pod", otel_scope_name="envoyproxy/ai-gateway", gen_ai_request_model=~"$model", gen_ai_backend=~"$backend"}[$__rate_interval]))

panels.title: Tokens by model
panels.description: Input and output tokens per second per model.

targets.expr: sum by (gen_ai_request_model) (rate(gen_ai_client_token_usage_sum{namespace=~"$namespace", pod=~"$pod", otel_scope_name="envoyproxy/ai-gateway", gen_ai_request_model=~"$model", gen_ai_backend=~"$backend", gen_ai_token_type="input"}[$__rate_interval]))

sum by (gen_ai_request_model) (rate(gen_ai_client_token_usage_sum{namespace=~"$namespace", pod=~"$pod", otel_scope_name="envoyproxy/ai-gateway", gen_ai_request_model=~"$model", gen_ai_backend=~"$backend", gen_ai_token_type="output"}[$__rate_interval]))

panels.title: Prompt cache hit share
panels.description: Share of input tokens served from the provider prompt cache.

targets.expr: sum by (gen_ai_request_model) (rate(gen_ai_client_token_usage_sum{namespace=~"$namespace", pod=~"$pod", otel_scope_name="envoyproxy/ai-gateway", gen_ai_request_model=~"$model", gen_ai_backend=~"$backend", gen_ai_token_type="cached_input"}[$__rate_interval])) / sum by (gen_ai_request_model) (rate(gen_ai_client_token_usage_sum{namespace=~"$namespace", pod=~"$pod", otel_scope_name="envoyproxy/ai-gateway", gen_ai_request_model=~"$model", gen_ai_backend=~"$backend", gen_ai_token_type="input"}[$__rate_interval]))

panels.title: Output tokens per request (p95)
panels.description: Distribution of generated tokens per request.

targets.expr: histogram_quantile(0.95, sum by (le, gen_ai_request_model) (rate(gen_ai_client_token_usage_bucket{namespace=~"$namespace", pod=~"$pod", otel_scope_name="envoyproxy/ai-gateway", gen_ai_request_model=~"$model", gen_ai_backend=~"$backend", gen_ai_token_type="output"}[$__rate_interval])))

panels.title: MCP methods by status
panels.description: MCP JSON-RPC methods handled by the proxy. status is success, failed or error.

targets.expr: sum by (mcp_method_name, status) (rate(mcp_method_count_total{namespace=~"$namespace", pod=~"$pod", otel_scope_name="envoyproxy/ai-gateway"}[$__rate_interval]))

panels.title: MCP failures by method
panels.description: Methods that did not succeed.

targets.expr: sum by (mcp_method_name, status) (rate(mcp_method_count_total{namespace=~"$namespace", pod=~"$pod", otel_scope_name="envoyproxy/ai-gateway", status!="success"}[$__rate_interval]))

panels.title: MCP request latency
panels.description: Duration of MCP requests through the proxy (mcp.request.duration, recorded in seconds).

targets.expr: histogram_quantile(0.5, sum by (le) (rate(mcp_request_duration_bucket{namespace=~"$namespace", pod=~"$pod", otel_scope_name="envoyproxy/ai-gateway"}[$__rate_interval])))
histogram_quantile(0.95, sum by (le) (rate(mcp_request_duration_bucket{namespace=~"$namespace", pod=~"$pod", otel_scope_name="envoyproxy/ai-gateway"}[$__rate_interval])))
histogram_quantile(0.99, sum by (le) (rate(mcp_request_duration_bucket{namespace=~"$namespace", pod=~"$pod", otel_scope_name="envoyproxy/ai-gateway"}[$__rate_interval])))

panels.title: MCP errors by type
panels.description: invalid_json_rpc, unsupported_method, invalid_session_id, internal_error...

targets.expr: sum by (error_type) (rate(mcp_request_duration_count{namespace=~"$namespace", pod=~"$pod", otel_scope_name="envoyproxy/ai-gateway", error_type!=""}[$__rate_interval]))

panels.title: MCP requests by backend
panels.description: MCP traffic per upstream MCP backend.

targets.expr: sum by (mcp_backend) (rate(mcp_method_count_total{namespace=~"$namespace", pod=~"$pod", otel_scope_name="envoyproxy/ai-gateway"}[$__rate_interval]))

panels.title: Capabilities negotiated
panels.description: Capabilities announced by clients and servers during initialize (tools, resources, prompts, sampling, elicitation...).

targets.expr: sum by (capability_type, capability_side) (rate(mcp_capabilities_negotiated_total{namespace=~"$namespace", pod=~"$pod", otel_scope_name="envoyproxy/ai-gateway"}[$__rate_interval]))

title: Envoy AI Gateway
